findings.acceptance: Integration owner accepted the finding and implementation; reviewer inspected the frozen repaired source before independent captures.
findings.accepted_fix: Retain selected-form state checks; freshly guard other editor scopes before READ exit and each UPDATE fill/Save, exempting only the selected subtree. Fresh global editor guards precede post-submit reloads.
findings.mechanism: The old evolving-state check covered only the selected form. A second native form with a newly nonempty New note field left that check unchanged; navigation then discarded it.
findings.problem: An intervening draft in a separate sibling editor could be discarded during READ exit or UPDATE submission/reload while the operation returned CONFIRMED.
findings.reproduction: Pure in-memory Surface with selected URL/Title form at root 1 and distinct New note composer at root 5. Only the composer changes from empty to nonempty; _checked_editor accepted the selected form. No app/browser calls or file writes were used for the reproduction.

findings.acceptance: Integration owner accepted the finding and implementation; reviewer inspected both control-flow changes in the frozen repaired source.
findings.accepted_fix: Stop candidate iteration immediately after the first established family returns, including failed extensions. _open also freshly guards current drafts before candidate navigation.
findings.mechanism: _learn_record_family returned after stopping an experiment, but the outer candidate loop continued to _open for the next form; the first-family break occurred only after that candidate loop.
findings.problem: Learning could discard a preserved failed-experiment draft when another initial form candidate remained.
findings.reproduction: Two distinct creation candidates on the entry page; first CREATE establishes, its READ exit stops on a new sibling draft, then the second candidate initiates navigation.

limits: A bounded review and the disclosed development checks do not establish general correctness or the complete prospective task battery.
remaining_review_result: No additional substantive defect identified in the bounded compatibility-invalidation, immutable version-publication, or READ/UPDATE output review.
review_scope: Bounded adversarial read-only review of P3 versus P2; no application or browser calls during review.
